label: Date type spike
info: Spike v4: column names with spaces and dots, nulls and missing keys in the legacy parquet engine. Output in Sandbox/spike/ of the data lake. Delete the tab after the test.

name: [1] SPIKE: BUILD ROWS
info: STAGE 1 - one inject, one function that builds the rows of all eight cases (day numbers for dates, ms for times). Each case has its own parquet node. Run once, then the result files in Sandbox/spike/ are read with pyarrow.

name: 1.1 Build spike rows
[2] CASE names_and_types_with_nulls
info: STAGE 2 - engine parquetjs: names with spaces, dots and a dash in the real types; row 2 has a null in every nullable column. The result is Sandbox/spike/names_and_types_with_nulls.parquet; a failure gives names_and_types_with_nulls_ERROR.txt.
